Title: TaskItem - ToDoList Data Model
Summary: Public data model representing a single to-do task item with date, completion status, title, and description.
Content:
## TaskItem

Public data model for a single to-do task item. Extends `Cyrena.Models.Entity`.

**Namespace:** `Cyrena.ToDoList.Models`

**Access:** `public`

### Properties

```csharp
public class TaskItem : Entity
{
    public DateTime Date { get; set; }
    public bool IsComplete { get; set; }
    [Required]
    public string? Title { get; set; }
    public string? Description { get; set; }
}
```

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `Id` | `string` | Inherited from `Entity`. Unique identifier. |
| `Date` | `DateTime` | The date the task is scheduled for. Stored as `.Date` (time truncated). |
| `IsComplete` | `bool` | Completion status. |
| `Title` | `string?` | Required task title. |
| `Description` | `string?` | Optional task description. |

### Notes
- `Date` is normalized to `.Date` (midnight) by `TaskItemService` on create and update.
- `Title` has `[Required]` data annotation for form validation.
- Inherits `Entity` base which provides only `Id`. No `CreatedAt`/`UpdatedAt` properties exist on this model.
